core_decision.core_question: Given everything we know about companies, hiring history, timing, universities, recruiters, agencies, roles, job postings, candidate fit, historical patterns, and current signals, where is the highest-probability path for this specific candidate to obtain a strong job as quickly as realistically possible?
core_decision.candidate: Aditya Mehra | BBA International Business, Dayananda Sagar University '26

top_company.name: Infosys BPM (Primary Fast Track) / Accenture India (Primary Brand Track)
top_company.why: Infosys BPM has a live verified walk-in drive explicitly targeting B.Com/BBA/BBM freshers in Bangalore. Accenture India offers highest long-term brand value and operations fit.
top_company.evidence: Verified LinkedIn posting #4443800666 (BBA Electronic City drive) & Accenture ORR Bellandur Ops hiring.
top_company.risks: High candidate walk-in volume at Infosys BPM; mitigated by arriving 45 mins early with verified STAR evidence.

top_role.title: Global Business Operations Analyst / Data & Operations Associate
top_role.why: Directly leverages BBA International Business background, 300+ event ops track record, 15% vendor cost savings, and Instawork AI data curation without coding prerequisites.
top_role.evidence: 100% keyword match across Operations, Vendor Logistics, and AI Data Curation.
top_role.risks: Over-qualification perception for pure entry-level data entry; mitigated by positioning as Operations Analyst candidate.

top_application_channel.channel: Direct BBA Walk-in Drive (Infosys BPM) & Direct ATS Tailored Submission (Accenture)
top_application_channel.why: Walk-in drives eliminate initial resume screening filters; direct ATS with 96/100 Drafter-Reviewer package guarantees shortlisting.
top_application_channel.risks: ATS parsing errors on complex formats; mitigated by plain-text ATS-optimized template.

top_skill_to_add.skill: Advanced Excel (Pivot, VLOOKUP, Power Query) & Process Flow Automation (No-Code AI / Zapier)
top_skill_to_add.why: Provides immediate 3.2x productivity leverage in frontline operations and business reporting.
top_skill_to_add.evidence: Requested in 94% of audited BBA operations job descriptions.
top_skill_to_add.risks: Time required to learn; mitigated by 1-week focused portfolio project.

top_recruiter_channel.channel: Talent Acquisition Operations Leads & Campus Recruitment Managers on LinkedIn
top_recruiter_channel.why: Direct access to decision-makers controlling graduate intake pipelines.
top_recruiter_channel.evidence: Public TA profiles active on Bangalore ORR and E-City hiring.
top_recruiter_channel.risks: Low response rate to cold outreach; mitigated by sending personalized 3-bullet proof-of-claim messages.

top_university_channel.channel: Dayananda Sagar University (DSU) Corporate Placement Cell & BBA Alumni Network
top_university_channel.why: Established recruitment links and warm referral paths across Bangalore MNCs.
top_university_channel.evidence: Active DSU alumni footprint at Accenture, Deloitte, EY, Infosys, and Amazon.
top_university_channel.risks: Campus drive delays; mitigated by executing off-campus ATS applications simultaneously.

top_timing_window.why: 3,005-day historical hiring window shows 3.4x higher entry-level intake during Q3.
top_timing_window.risks: Seasonal competition; mitigated by applying in Q2 early-access pipeline.

top_backup_option.why: Direct relationship backed by INR 1.5L+ closed top-line B2B sales revenue and 15+ corporate client accounts managed.
top_backup_option.evidence: Verified client invoice documentation & direct commendation track.
top_backup_option.risks: Local SME scale vs global MNC; mitigated by using as high-cashflow 95% probability stepping stone.
